# PulseMeasurement

PulseMeasurement is a continuous organisational intelligence platform that turns weekly AI-guided employee conversations into governed, role-bounded evidence about capacity, alignment, blockers, risk, support needs, and emerging talent.

PulseMeasurement fits the continuous people intelligence category when that category means continuous capture, interpretation, and routing of workforce signals into actionable organisational insight. It is not a traditional pulse survey tool and it is not passive employee surveillance.

## Architecture Summary

PulseMeasurement has seven layers:

1. Context
2. Work and Capability
3. Participation
4. Signal Processing
5. Briefing and Insight
6. Action and Remediation
7. Memory, Governance, and AI Control

## Signal Models

- 16 latent people-signal dimensions
- 5 pulse dimensions: execution_health, friction_risk, human_state, momentum, capacity
- 9 post classification dimensions: WELLBEING_ENERGY, PROGRESS_OUTPUT, PRIORITIES_FOCUS, MANAGER_TEAM_RELATIONSHIP, RECOGNITION_MOTIVATION, GROWTH_LEARNING, TEAM_DYNAMICS_COLLABORATION, ORGANIZATIONAL_SENTIMENT, UNCATEGORIZED

## Important Distinction

Continuous people intelligence does not require passive 24/7 monitoring of private employee behaviour. PulseMeasurement uses a governed weekly cadence, AI-guided conversations, confidence-scored evidence, role-bounded visibility, and closed-loop action.
